items.title: RMD Q3 deep dive: product innovation and supply chain execution drive results amid evolving landscape
items.summary: Medical device company ResMed (NYSE:RMD) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in calendar Q3 2026 (fiscal Q1 2027), with sales up 5.9% year on year to $1.41 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.91 per share was 8.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
